=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 147-156, 240-247, 536-716 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The sensitive-path filter and related path caps were deleted, allowing credential-bearing files such as .env*, .git/config, .netrc, .npmrc, .pypirc, .docker/config.json, and .aws/credentials to be inlined into model context.
  WHY: Untrusted plan or issue paths can cause secrets to be copied into editor prompts and committed output; repository containment does not prevent sensitive in-repo files from being read.

- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url at lines 3040-3052; _resolve_origin_url lines 3077-3084; _run_git error formatting at lines 3015-3021 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication was changed from command-scoped headers to token-bearing URLs, exposing credentials in argv, git configuration, and error output, while the new lookup ignores GH_PAT.
  WHY: Memory clone/fetch/push operations can leak tokens and fail in GH_PAT-only environments; severity disagreement was resolved using the highest severity reported.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url, lines 565-592 / 569-587; clone call sites, lines 770 and 886 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Token-in-URL authentication replaced _memory_git and no longer strips existing origin userinfo.
  WHY: Tokens can appear in process arguments, clone configuration, and diagnostics, while credential-bearing origins can produce malformed double-credential URLs; severity disagreement was resolved using the highest severity reported.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: line 1989 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The automated judge-fix path calls the removed git_with_github_auth helper without a fallback.
  WHY: The judge-fix commit cannot be pushed and review-blocked pull requests remain stuck for manual intervention.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 29-38, 663-744 / lines 29-38, 663-713, 738-746 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports MAX_TARGET_PATHS and is_sensitive_target_path after those symbols were removed.
  WHY: pytest raises ImportError during collection, and the sensitive-path, zero-budget, and bounded-output tests would also fail semantically.

- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py: lines 95-99 / lines 96-98 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The authentication hygiene test still asserts that _memory_git is used after the helper was removed.
  WHY: The literal assertions fail, causing the test module to report authentication regressions.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context lines 536-716 / lines 538-716 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: used_bytes counts raw file contents but not headers, wrappers, markers, footers, summaries, or the removed path-count limits.
  WHY: Rendered targeted context can exceed the documented hard max_bytes limit and callers can receive larger-than-budget model input.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context function, lines 562-564 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: max_bytes <= 0 now returns a non-empty disabled-context message instead of the previously documented empty string.
  WHY: Callers using an empty result to skip context embedding and test_disabled_by_zero_max_bytes receive unexpected content.

- scripts/label_helpers.sh: lines 65 and 118 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: ai:merge-queued was added to the helper catalog but not to .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json.
  WHY: Strict catalog/contract equality tests fail and the label is unused.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: module-level constants removed (MAX_TARGET_PATHS, MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES, is_sensitive_target_path) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Public module identifiers were removed without aliases or compatibility shims.
  WHY: Existing importers, including in-repository tests and consumer hooks, fail with ImportError.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_git at former lines 595-615 / former lines ~598-608 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The _memory_git helper was removed without preserving the symbol.
  WHY: Existing tests and out-of-tree consumers that invoke the helper fail.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context() line 580 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: OSError guards around stat() and read_bytes() were removed.
  WHY: A file disappearing or becoming unreadable between is_file() and stat() raises out of emit_context instead of degrading to a missing marker.

- scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh: lines 337-349 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The timeout handler prints an emit_failed marker and exits with status 0.
  WHY: Callers cannot distinguish timed-out emission from success; severity disagreement was noted because moonshotai_kimi-k3 and deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro treated the established fail-open behavior as intentional rather than defective.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url, lines 564-592 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The origin-only fallback can preserve embedded origin userinfo after the old stripping behavior was removed.
  WHY: Custom non-CI origins may expose or propagate credentials, although the reviewer noted the CI path is generally unaffected.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context for rel in paths at line 568; MAX_TARGET_PATHS (256) removed | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: No path-count or path-length cap remains before filesystem and Semble work.
  WHY: Large path lists can cause excessive path walking and subprocess activity.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Run model-facing processes with a sanitized environment and perform authenticated GitHub operations only in separate trusted actuator steps."
  expected_change_site: Every workflow YAML that launches a model-facing step with repository credentials in env.
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: review_autofix.yml isolates the review editor, but implement.yml and validate.yml were not modified and may still pass credentials to model-facing steps.

- requirement: "Isolate model-facing processes from repository credentials … restrict terminal approvals to current maintainers and administrators, and bind ready-to-merge mutations to the head whose checks passed."
  expected_change_site: scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, and the heredoc python in scripts/ledger_emit_substate.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR replaces command-scoped http.extraHeader authentication with token-in-URL embedding in git ls-remote, git clone, git push, and related error paths, reintroducing the credential exposure the requirement was intended to remove.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
